localFacts.text: The Irvine Business Complex, in the northwest of the city, contains offices, industrial properties, homes and mixed-use developments.
Newport Beach includes distinct villages such as Balboa, Lido Marina Village and Corona del Mar.
Old Town Tustin centers on historic buildings along Main Street and El Camino Real, with buildings dating to the 1880s.
Tustin Legacy is the city's mixed-use redevelopment of the former military base.
Costa Mesa is home to South Coast Plaza, Segerstrom Center for the Arts and South Coast Repertory.
The LAB and The CAMP helped establish the SoBECA district around Bristol Street.
Laguna Beach has coastal, hillside and canyon settings around its downtown; the city trail system overlooks the Pacific and surrounding canyons.
The city identifies Bluebird Canyon, Downtown and Temple Hills as distinct neighborhood areas.
Aliso Viejo was master-planned to combine residential neighborhoods with parks, schools, offices, businesses and retail.
Aliso Viejo has rolling hills and valley terrain, with views toward mountains, parks and city lights.
The downtown planning area combines pedestrian-oriented shopping with office, residential and live-work building types.
The city identifies Logan and Lacy as established historic residential neighborhoods within the transit zoning area.
The Platinum Triangle includes mixed-use, office, restaurant and residential development in an area historically occupied by industry.
The Platinum Triangle connects with I-5, SR-57 and SR-22 and includes ARTIC, the regional transportation center.
Downtown Huntington Beach is a beachside, pedestrian-oriented district; its plan includes commercial areas around Main Street, the Waterfront and Pacific City.
Old Towne centers on Plaza Park, with shops, galleries and restaurants; Chapman University and the Orange Metrolink Station are also part of the area.
Orange recognizes Old Towne and the Fairhaven, Fairhills and Fairmeadow Eichler neighborhoods as historic districts.
Oso Creek and Lake Mission Viejo are distinct local landscape features connected with the city trail network.
Mission Viejo has multiple separate shopping and business centers, including Alicia Towne Plaza, Jeronimo Business Center and La Paz Plaza.
Foothill Ranch and Portola Hills are neighborhoods within Lake Forest, added as the city expanded northeast.
Foothill Ranch combines residential, commercial and business-park uses.
Dana Point distinguishes its Lantern District / Town Center from the harbor in its long-range planning.
The city has a coastal setting with harbor areas, beaches and trails near ocean bluffs.
San Clemente identifies North Beach, the Pier Bowl, the Downtown Core and El Camino Real west of I-5 within its architectural overlay area.
The coastal Beach Trail links North Beach and Calafia Beach, passing the pier and T-Street.
The Urban Village area combines retail, office, medical, residential and transportation uses near I-5 and Paseo de Valencia.
The former Laguna Hills Mall site is the subject of the Village at Laguna Hills redevelopment plans; it should not be described as a completed new district.
Mile Square Regional Park is a major urban park within Fountain Valley.
Fountain Valley lies north of Huntington Beach and Costa Mesa and south of Santa Ana, placing it between coastal and inland Orange County communities.
Bolsa Avenue near Moran Street and the Asian Garden Mall forms the heart of Westminster's Little Saigon commercial and cultural district.
Garden Grove's Historic Main Street is a brick-lined downtown district beside the Village Green and the Gem Theatre.
The city identifies OC Koreatown, Little Saigon and Historic Main Street as distinct local destinations.
